About the camp

The Faculty of Education Leadership Camp 2027 takes place over three days, 29–31 January 2027, and is open to everyone.

Leaders are built through shared challenges, honest conversations and the trust of a team. The camp brings people together outdoors to practise exactly that, away from desks and screens.

Theme and objectives

Called to Lead, Chosen to Serve

Develop leadership skills

Enhance teamwork and collaboration

Improve communication skills

Build confidence and problem-solving abilities
